title: National Commission must issue instructions for uniform procedure
description: The National Commission shall issue instructions regarding adoption of uniform procedure in hearing of matters

content.what: shall issue instructions regarding adoption of uniform procedure
conditions: prior service of copies of documents produced by one party to the opposite parties
furnishing of english translation of judgments written in any language
speedy grant of copies of documents
limitations: without interfering with their quasi-judicial freedom
